findings.title: Empty birth inputs lack a sufficiently contrasting visual boundary
findings.expected: Enabled empty manual fields remain visually identifiable without relying on current value, focus, hover or placeholder text; required boundary/fill reaches 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11).
findings.actual: After clearing manual Latitude and blurring it, border-to-fill is 1.3934:1 light and 1.7864:1 dark; border-to-surround is 1.3263:1 and 1.7439:1. A focused Timezone ring passes, but does not identify the other unfocused empty fields.
reproduction: Clear Latitude, Longitude and Timezone; move focus away from the coordinate field being measured.
Inspect empty enabled controls in both themes.
findings.cause: The shared birth inputClass uses low-contrast border-input and a card fill close to the surrounding surface.

findings.title: Signed coordinate fields request a keypad that may omit minus
findings.expected: The manual path supports accepted negative coordinates without needing geocoding, a hardware keyboard or clipboard workaround.
findings.actual: Latitude and Longitude request inputMode=decimal while validation accepts negative decimal values. Current MDN documents that decimal keyboards may omit minus. Programmatic -33.8688/-151.2093 entry succeeds in both proxies; no physical-keyboard failure is claimed.
reproduction: Read the manual coordinate input configuration and accepted-value validator.
On the target, focus the manual fields and try typing negative values with the software keyboard without pasting.
Record the actual OS, browser, keyboard, locale and available sign keys; leave untested configurations unresolved.
findings.cause: Keyboard hint is narrower than the accepted signed input on some potential target keyboard configurations; exact affected device/keyboard versions need acquisition.

cleanup.reason: Owned server stopped after PID command/cwd verification; both named audit browsers closed. All 2550 pre-existing file hashes, non-owned Git status, HEAD and prior ledger unchanged. Owned run/report artifacts retained.

limitations: Ceiling proxy: Linux Chromium 155.0.8059.12 and Playwright WebKit 26.6. WebKit is not Safari. No native keyboard, mobile chrome, real insets, system gestures, physical touch feel or screen-reader execution.
All server/member/auth/model/billing/ephemeris services are synthetic. Some fixture service defaults return {ok:true}; unimplemented methods are unqualified. No production writes performed.
Fixture bootstrap/head/eager imports replace production SSR and chunking. Performance acquisition timed out; LCP, INP, CLS, TBT and field percentiles are not measured.
200% root-font stress is not native page/text enlargement; desktop Back and Escape are not Android system Back.
Original F-01/F-02/F-03 ledger, statuses, failures and device plans remain unchanged. Current proxy passes neither verify those fixes nor refute prior intermittent observations.
Phone build and safe test backend are not provisioned; all 10 device entries remain not_run with blank actuals and no evidence.
No full populated natal placement/aspect table, connected-assistant, admin-content, live checkout or actual generated-reading quality qualification.
next_steps: Review/apply the two ordinary scoped color proposals only if source edits are requested.
Acquire C-P01 through C-P04 software-keyboard evidence before narrowing F-06 scope or selecting a device-specific alternative.
Provision the named safe phone build/backend and run the ten planned entries, recording actual versions, widths, build and setup separately.
Supply a production origin, collection window and RUM/CrUX access for field performance; failed development acquisition cannot replace it.

history.reason: Default audit_only mode; current source rechecked. Prior immutable run retained separately; no status/history mutation.
focused-v1 hidden-radio targeting failed; original scripts/errors retained. focused-v2 uses the visible label, not forced input activation.

Initial inventory was captured after ledger init, so it included this run owned run.json. Growth of that owned ledger and new report artifacts are expected; preservation checks compare all pre-existing files and all non-owned Git entries.

findings.title: Reflection textarea boundary contrast is too low in light and dark themes
WebKit mouse activation can miss Energy after a scroll reset
Route navigation restarts keyboard focus at document chrome

prior_audit.relationship: Immutable earlier audit-and-fix ledger; this is a fresh audit_only run. No prior device results or status promotions; new findings start F-04.

recommendations.title: Make the brand home-link hit area at least 44px tall when next touching Shell
recommendations.reason: Rendered brand link is 40px high; tested primary controls are at least44px. This is ergonomic/project consistency guidance, not a 24px AA target-size failure.

recommendations.title: Consider local jump links for account settings on the long Context & privacy page
recommendations.reason: The account controls follow the lengthy source/consent content on the sampled phone route. In-page links can shorten repeated access while retaining the existing design and content; no redesign or new native API required.

accessibility.evidence: Good semantics/focus but two measured contrast defects; screen readers untested.

performance.evidence: Throttled development acquisition timed out; no representative performance values. Unscored to avoid inventing a result.

theming.evidence: Consistent tokens, both themes rendered; selected helper and input border contrast need repair.

responsive.evidence: 216 geometry states and native-like proxy interactions pass; hardware keyboard/chrome/gesture qualification absent.

implementation_integrity.evidence: Source detector empty; product-specific chapter/evidence/draft structure, shared tokens and controls retained.

audit_scorecard.assessed_subtotal: 12/16 across four assessed dimensions; no /20 total or overall rating because performance is unscored.
